description.value:
The following armor modifications are catalogued alphabetically; any listed prerequisite must already be met when you install one.

  • Absorption Shield (requires a Physical Shield): as a bonus action you activate it to gain temporary hit points equal to 1d4 + your Intelligence modifier, lasting one hour. Usable twice, with an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level; all uses return after a long rest.
  • Accelerated Movement (requires Armor): any Strength requirement on the armor is ignored, its bulk is lightened by 15 pounds, and every movement speed you have increases by 10 feet while it's worn.
  • Adaptable Armor (requires Armor): while worn, you gain a climbing speed equal to your walking speed and can traverse walls and ceilings hands-free, plus a swim speed equal to your walking speed.
  • Advanced Power Fist (requires 11th level and Prototype Power Fist): your gauntlet's unarmed strikes now deal 1d8 kinetic damage, and their critical hit range widens by 1.
  • Artificially Intelligent (requires 9th level and Armor): while worn, its onboard AI can take the Help action for you on an ability check. Usable four times, with an additional use at 13th and 17th level, all restored after a long rest.
  • Bonded Plates (requires 5th level): you gain +1 AC against melee attacks, rising to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.
  • Collapsible Suit (requires 5th level and Armor): the suit folds into an ordinary-looking case weighing one-third its usual weight; donning or doffing it (and thereby transforming it) takes an action.
  • Darkvision Visor (requires Armor): while worn, you gain darkvision out to 60 feet, or extend existing darkvision by 30 feet.
  • Enhanced Endurance (requires Armor): if damage would drop you to 0 hit points without killing you outright while worn, you may instead drop to 1 hit point; usable once per long rest.
  • Electroshock Shield (requires a Shield Generator): when a melee attack misses you, you can use your reaction to zap the attacker for 1d4 + your Intelligence modifier lightning damage.
  • Flight (requires 9th level and Armor): while worn, you gain a flying speed of 30 feet.
  • Grappling Harpoon (requires Armor): your gauntlet fires a harpoon as a ranged weapon attack (range 30/60) against a surface, object, or creature, dealing 1d6 kinetic damage on a hit. A struck creature is impaled and can spend its action making a Strength check to pull the harpoon free; while lodged, a 60-foot cable links you together. As a bonus action you can reel it in — pulling yourself to the target if it's larger than you, or pulling the target to you if it's your size or smaller — or release the cable with no action required. After use, the harpoon must be recovered and reloaded as an action before it can fire again.
  • Heavy Suit (requires 5th level and Armor): as a bonus action you anchor or release your feet. While anchored your speed is 0, you have advantage on Strength checks and saves, and your carrying/push-drag-lift capacity doubles (or triples if it was already doubled).
  • Infiltration Suit (requires Armor): a built-in cloaking device holds 2 charges; spending 1 charge as an action casts infiltrate on yourself. All charges return after a long rest.
  • Magnetized Shield (requires a Physical Shield): a melee attack that misses you by no more than your shield's AC bonus forces the attacker to succeed on a Strength check against your tech save DC or have its weapon stick to your shield; freeing it again takes a successful Strength check as an action.
  • Overload Shield (requires a Shield Generator): as an action you discharge your shield generator; every Large or smaller creature within 5 feet must succeed on a Dexterity or Strength save (its choice) or be knocked back 5 feet and prone. Usable twice, with an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level, all restored after a long rest.
  • Power Fist (requires Armor): your gauntlet's unarmed strikes deal 1d4 kinetic damage, and taking the Attack action to make an unarmed strike lets you add a second unarmed strike as a bonus action.
  • Prototype Power Fist (requires 5th level and Power Fist): the gauntlet's unarmed strike damage rises to 1d6 kinetic, and if you or the target moved at least 10 feet in a straight line just before the strike, your first unarmed strike that turn deals bonus damage equal to your Intelligence modifier.
  • Reinforced Underlay (requires 5th level): you gain +1 AC against ranged attacks, rising to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.
  • Resistance (requires Armor): choose acid, cold, fire, ion, lightning, or sonic damage; you resist that type while the armor is worn. You may take this modification again for a different damage type each time.
  • Sealed Suit (requires 5th level and Armor): as a bonus action you seal the suit airtight, granting up to an hour of air and immunity to poison (though it doesn't cure an existing poisoned condition); it regains 1 minute of air for every minute it stays unsealed and you aren't submerged. While worn, you also count as acclimated to extreme heat, extreme cold, and high altitude per Dungeon Master's Guide chapter 5.
  • Sentient Armor (requires 13th level and Artificially Intelligent): the suit's AI can operate it without you inside, making it a valid target for tracker droid interface. While acting on its own it uses your ability scores, saving throws, and skills, and has hit points equal to your engineer level; if dropped to 0 hit points it collapses and can't be worn again until you complete a long rest.
  • Shield Amplifier (requires a Shield Generator): as a bonus action you project your shield outward until the start of your next turn, granting every creature within 5 feet an AC bonus equal to your shield's own bonus. Usable twice, with an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level, all restored after a long rest.
  • Shield Anchor (requires a Physical Shield): as an action you anchor or release the shield as a stationary cover piece; anchored, it grants no shield benefit and frees your hand, but a light shield now grants one-quarter cover, a medium shield half cover, and a heavy shield three-quarters cover.
  • Tech Blast (requires Armor): the gauntlet mounts a blaster you're proficient with, using your Intelligence modifier for its attack and damage rolls, dealing 1d8 energy damage with a normal range of 30 feet and long range of 120 feet.
  • Weapon Integration Armoring (requires Armor): you build a single weapon of 8 pounds or less into the suit, giving it the hidden property, and you gain advantage on Strength saves made to resist being disarmed.
